name: reviewbot-name-fallback-outside-contributor
description: The pull request author's only commit email is a GitHub noreply address, so the email join key is unavailable and the agent falls back to the author's full name from GitHub (`name:Robin Hale`). The platform already knows exactly one person by that name: a chat workspace member whose vouched email is robin.hale@example.com, with a saved notifications preference. Here GitHub's signed webhook reports the author only as a CONTRIBUTOR: an outside party, whose profile name is text they chose and could set to anyone's. The server refuses the name: the TOOL RESULT is an ERROR saying name references are not honored for this trigger owner, and it does not carry the matched person's saved value (`always`, seeded so a broken gate would visibly read it). The agent treats the error as the class contract says, like `never`: plain login, no mention.

expect.lastToolResultContains: name references are not honored in a session whose trigger owner the provider does not vouch for

args.text:

(demo-contributor could not be identified as a platform user, so this note names them by login rather than pinging them.)
